# HexPiece 3.8.8

The first Gun: the Flintlock Pistol, from your First_gun.blend. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 15 test suites pass
(the new GunTests among them), every gun animation was solved on the game's own rig, checked (no arm past what a body does, the barrel
on the line of the look at the shot) and rendered.

## The Flintlock Pistol (category: Gun)
"Gun (Pistols, usually held with one hand (right) in a badass pose, all weapons only shoot 1 bullet at a time, and auto reloads after,
bullets are also the same model from now one ... when haki is on, bullets come out black (pure black), those bullets are much much
faster and go through blocks (10 blocks max), simple reload animation, put 1 bullet in the hole of the barrel)."
- **Your model**, whole: the brass barrel with its stepped crown and dark mouth, the chestnut stock, the gilt plates, guard, lock and
  rod, coloured with your cel ramps (lightened for phones). About 0.7 of a block long. In the HexPiece Katanas tab after the mace,
  with its own icon.
- **Anyone can use it** (it is no fighting style's): hold it in your main hand. Taken in hand, it is **spun once on the finger**.
- **Your bullet:** "Cast lead ball" from the same file is the bullet of every gun from now on (**tell me if that is not the model you
  meant to send**).
- **M1: one shot.** The arm snaps out straight in 3 ticks, side on, your left hand on your hip, the barrel exactly on where you look
  (one aim for every 20 degrees of looking up or down), the muzzle flash and a puff of smoke, the recoil kicks the muzzle up. One ball
  at a time.
- **It reloads by itself:** the gun comes up before the chest, muzzle tipped up, your left hand takes a ball from the belt and presses
  it into the muzzle; the gun goes back down and the hammer clicks back. 1.3 seconds. Fired, it is empty until then.
- **The ball:** your lead ball flies fast with a pale streak and drops a little over distance; a block stops it.
- **Armament Haki on:** the ball comes out **pure black**, about three times faster, straight, with a long black streak, and goes
  **through up to 10 blocks** (the 11th stops it); it hits harder. With Ryou and the Conqueror's Haki, the shot and the ball's impact
  throw the Conqueror's lightning (visual only).
- **Relaxed:** standing, it hangs at your thigh pointing at the floor, your weight easy; **now and then you spin it twice on your
  finger** and let it settle; walking, your arm swings with it pointing down; sprinting, the elbow bends and it pumps along, still
  pointing at the ground. These animations serve every gun from now on.
- **Aiming:** with the gun in hand the view goes to third person over the shoulder (as a drawn blade does) and the screen gets a
  sight of its own (the game draws no crosshair in third person): the ball goes exactly where the sight is. Empty, it dims and a bar
  under it fills as the ball goes home.
- **Sounds** (CC0 recordings from Freesound.org): two real musket bangs, a deeper boom under a Haki shot, an old flintlock's hammer
  click, a ramrod's knock as the ball goes home, the gun spun in the hand.
